content.p1: Give your photos a timeless, classic look by converting them to grayscale. Our tool removes color information while preserving the details, creating high-quality black and white images.
content.p2: Using the standard luminance formula, we ensure that the conversion accurately reflects human perception of brightness, resulting in natural-looking monochrome photos.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is grayscale the same as black and white?
faq.a1: Yes, in photography terms, 'black and white' usually refers to grayscale images containing various shades of gray.
faq.q2: Does this work on all devices?
faq.a2: Yes, it works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers directly in the browser.
